verdict.rationale: Pigment documents first-party natural-language operation. The Modeler Agent builds and maintains planning models from natural-language intent, and the Analyst Agent builds reports from simple conversations. Its official MCP server also lets users build and edit models and query business data from Claude, Cursor, Codex, or ChatGPT. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that NL commands work reliably, in-depth docs (beyond marketing pages) on the scope and limits of NL-driven operations.
